owner: feature/transcript-pipeline stream T1 (backend). WEB (T2) and ANDROID (T3) copy this file verbatim and load their mocks from `examples` and `fixtures`.
enforcedBy: backend/tests/test_transcript_contract.py: every route below exists with its method, every example validates against backend/app/transcription/transcript/schema.py, and every fixture is reproduced byte for byte by backend/app/transcription/transcript/render.py
rules: Identical in designer-portal and documentation-portal (shared/transcription.sha256 lists it).

Base path /api/transcripts. {mediaId} is MediaFile.id: every recording in both portals (Field Repository media, questionnaire takes, artisan record media, designer workshop media, designer dictation).
All times are ISO-8601 UTC. startMs/endMs are milliseconds from the start of the audio.
Field order is not normative. Extra response fields need a contractVersion bump.
Errors are {detail:{code,message}} with an UPPER_SNAKE code from errorCodes. A 404 with code NOT_FOUND also covers 'you may not read this transcript'.
Every route answers 404 NOT_FOUND while the feature switch is off (TRANSCRIPT_PIPELINE_ENABLED); clients then draw the legacy plain transcript.
Text from the server is plain text or our own markdown (render.py). Clients show markdown through a sanitised renderer: no raw HTML, ever.
The client never builds copy text itself unless it reproduces fixtures.copy byte for byte; otherwise it asks POST /copy.
Turn ids are stable for a version. A new version (re-transcription) gets new turn ids; edits and speaker names carry across by speakerKey and index only where noted.

enums.pipelineStatusNotes: WAITING_FOR_CONSENT: a subject refused external processing; nothing was sent. QUEUED also covers 'paused' and 'outside the nightly window' (see view.queueReason). TRANSCRIBE_NOW is shown to admins only (view.permissions.transcribeNow). RETRY is shown to whoever may edit (view.permissions.retry). READY with translation FAILED on some turns still reads READY; those turns carry translation.status FAILED.

routes.notes: Current version. ?version=N reads an older one (read only).
Header badges for lists. Unreadable ids are left out.
Applies to every turn, every version and every copy.
An edited original marks its English STALE. 409 STALE_REVISION when baseRevision is behind.
Synchronous, one turn, consent re-checked. 409 CONSENT_REFUSED / BUDGET_PAUSED.
Needs attention -> Queued. Re-runs translation only when transcription already succeeded.

routes.query: format=md|docx|srt|vtt&track=original|english|both (srt/vtt: original|english)&timestamps=true|false (md/docx; false drops the time on every turn, default true)

routes.notes: Answers from this transcript only; consent re-checked; counts against budget.
Questionnaire takes only (409 NOT_A_QUESTIONNAIRE_TAKE). Drafts land in the existing AI drafts flow; locked answers and recordings-preferred questions are skipped and listed.
409 CONSENT_REFUSED when any quoted artisan withdrew.

TranscriptView.title: string  e.g. 'Interview · Giriraj Prasad Chhipa · 24 Jun 2026'
TranscriptView.statusMessage: string|null  one calm sentence for NEEDS_ATTENTION / WAITING_FOR_CONSENT
TranscriptView.version: int|null  null before the first run
TranscriptView.languages: [{code: 'hi', label: 'Hindi'}]  in order of share of speech
TranscriptView.badges: [{kind: 'stt'|'translation', provider: string, model: string, label: 'Scribe v2'|'Gemini 3.8 Flash'}]  ADMIN, MASTER_ADMIN and MINISTRY_ADMIN only; [] for everyone else (also on TranscriptSummary and VersionInfo)
TranscriptView.summary: [string]  up to five English lines (existing insights), [] when none
TranscriptView.quotes: [{turnId: string|null, original: string, english: string, speaker: string|null}]
TranscriptView.cost: {sttUsd: number, translationUsd: number, totalUsd: number}|null  ADMIN, MASTER_ADMIN and MINISTRY_ADMIN only, else null
TranscriptView.audio: {url: string|null, durationMs: int|null, cleaned: bool, originalUrl: string|null}  url is the signed media url: the Voice Isolator copy when cleaned is true (originalUrl is then the recording as made), else the recording itself
TranscriptView.permissions: {edit: bool, retry: bool, transcribeNow: bool, ask: bool, autodraft: bool, quoteCard: bool, mapSpeakers: bool}
TranscriptView.readOnly: {code: 'NOT_EDITOR'|'HELD_POST', message: string}|null  why this reader may read but not change it (edit, speakers, re-translate, retry, auto-draft), by the same rule every write refuses by; null when they may. Clients show the message once and offer none of those controls
TranscriptView.revision: int  bumps on every edit or speaker change; send back as baseRevision

Speaker.label: string  the mapped name, else 'Speaker 1'
Speaker.name: string|null
Speaker.suggested: bool  true when label comes from a suggestion nobody confirmed
Speaker.sample: {startMs: int, endMs: int}|null  a few seconds of this speaker (their longest turn, at most 8 s) to play when naming them

Turn.speakerName: string  as Speaker.label (the copy uses this)
Turn.text: string  the current original (edited if edited, else machine)
Turn.lowConfidence: [[start, end)]  Unicode code-point offsets into text (equal to UTF-16 offsets for every Indic script) where Scribe was unsure; [] once edited
Turn.words: [{text: string, startMs: int, endMs: int, offset: int}]  karaoke; offset is the character index of the word in text; [] once edited
Turn.translation: {text: string|null, status: translationStatus, source: textSource, model: string|null}

SpeakerMappingBody.mappings: [{speakerKey: string, name: string (1..80) | null to clear, role: speakerRole|null, personId: string|null}]

SpeakerSuggestion.candidates: [{name: string, role: speakerRole, personId: string|null, reason: 'roster'|'researcher'|'uploader'|'most_speech'}]

CopyBody.turnIds: [string]|null  null = Copy all (with the header); a list = Copy selected (no header), in transcript order
CopyBody.single: bool  true with exactly one turnId: the per-turn copy (text only, no speaker line)

AskAnswer.covered: bool  false = the transcript does not cover the question
AskAnswer.citations: [{turnId: string, startMs: int, quote: string|null}]  every turnId exists in this version; a quote is a verbatim span of that turn's original or English

AutoDraftResult.drafted: [{questionId: string, answerOriginal: string, answerEnglish: string, citations: [{turnId, startMs, quote}]}]
AutoDraftResult.draftsUrl: string  where the drafts flow shows them

QuoteCard.clip: {startMs: int, endMs: int, url: string|null}  the audio of those turns, with 500 ms padding, clamped
QuoteCard.markdown: string  same shape as a Copy both of those turns, plus an attribution line

rules: English of a turn whose translation is ALREADY_ENGLISH is its original text; 'both' then prints the original once, with no quote line.
English of a turn with no translation text (PENDING/FAILED) prints the original under 'english', and nothing under the quote for 'both'.
STALE English is still printed (it is the last good translation).
A multi-line English turn quotes every line with '> '.
Markdown-significant characters in turn text are NOT escaped: the text is what was said. Speaker names have '*', '`', '|' removed.
